description: This file defines structures, macros, and function declarations related to GST protection metadata, specifically for Rialto media server integration with GStreamer. It includes definitions for GstRialtoProtectionData and GstRialtoProtectionMetadata structures, as well as external function declarations for type and info retrieval.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Function to retrieve the GType for the protection metadata, used in GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Function to retrieve metadata information for the protection metadata.
